digest.component_or_area: automated-quality lint and type-check gate enforcement
propositions: Function complexity (C901) baseline at threshold 15 must be wired into the canonical lint gate without triggering on pre-existing violations.
Four Mypy settings (no_implicit_optional, strict_equality, warn_redundant_casts, warn_unused_ignores) must be enabled after revalidating measured diagnostics and resolving pre-existing violations.
Ruff ASYNC and DTZ rules must be enabled after making three datetime sites timezone-explicit and resolving pre-existing violations.
Ruff RUF hygiene rules must be enabled by clearing RUF100 and other approved diagnostics while deferring RUF001, RUF002, and RUF003.
All newly-enforced gates (C901, Mypy flags, Ruff ASYNC/DTZ, Ruff RUF) must exit zero against current origin/main before landing.
Pre-existing ratchet-family diagnostics on current origin/main must be resolved before their corresponding gate is landed.
